Paragraph: "And if she with slender eyelids on her eyes, decent hairdo, and a soft spoken one, Oh! Soumitri, if she is unseen by me will there be any purposefulness of my life?
Situation/Problem_Faced: Rama feels that life lacks meaning or purpose without Seetha.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama questions the very value of his life in the absence of his beloved wife.
Outcome/Resolution: He lays bare his existential despair and total devotion to Seetha.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Feelings of Hopelessness: Loss of Purpose, Existential Despair, Questioning Life's Value

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: An-artha / Loss of Purushartha (Feeling that life's purpose is meaningless without one's divine counterpart)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Expresses total spiritual inter-dependence: without the presence of divine grace (Seetha), life feels devoid of supreme goal or purpose.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Existential despair resulting from severe relational loss, leading the individual to question the meaning and purpose of continued existence.
